title: Record the three-bit rank-one idempotent count
body:
## Summary
- The three-bit matrix ring has 28 rank-one idempotents: seven nonzero image vectors, four dual vectors of trace one each, and all 28 products distinct.
- The other 21 rank-one matrices have trace zero and are not idempotent.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that count. It does not search words.

## Test plan
